title: Search Insert Position
summary: Find the target index or the insertion position that preserves sorted order.

input.hint: JSON object: { array: sorted number[], target: number }

visual.representation: Sorted array with moving binary-search bounds, midpoint, and final return/insertion index.

approach.explanation: Perform binary search on the sorted array. If the target is found, return its index. If not found, when the search interval collapses (left > right), the left pointer points to the insertion index that maintains sorted order.
